policy: Personal phones are not bound to vehicles.
Searchable vehicle selection requires a connection.
One active driving session per vehicle and driver.
Occupied requests are blocked and flagged.
Open disputes hold the vehicle until administrator resolution.
Administrator resolution requires a note and a current-session snapshot.
Location capture and delayed uploads retain original driving-session ownership.

references.usedFor: Selectable vehicle row only. Search, occupancy and dispute rules come from Fleet requirements.

development: Pre-production; migrations may be rewritten and the local database reset.

scheduling.designSnapshot: The 14 Figma screens precede scheduling; current schedule and attention screens are implemented in code.
scheduling.dispatch: A daily driver/vehicle allocation can support several dispatch jobs; Dispatch remains a placeholder.
